release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD1228T-3 is a bi-spectrum thermography network turret camera combining a 256x192 uncooled VOx thermal module (NETD <= 40 mK) with a 4 MP optical channel and accurate temperature measurement from -20 to 550 C. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2TD1228T-3_QAB_Datasheet_en-US_20240123.pdf.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels.
